name: antigravity-cli-bridge
description: Delegate Codex analysis tasks to Antigravity CLI in sandboxed plan mode with strict model control.

interface.shortDescription: Sandboxed Antigravity consultation for deep project analysis
interface.longDescription: Delegates one-shot project analysis from Codex to Antigravity CLI in non-interactive print mode. It fixes the requested model, forces plan mode and the Antigravity sandbox, passes explicit workspace context, and wraps the plain-text CLI response in auditable JSON.
defaultPrompt: Review this project with all related files for technical and business risks, then return one actionable report.
Analyze these backend and frontend files together to find vulnerabilities, logic flaws, and regression risks.
Perform a one-shot architecture and delivery-risk audit using the full linked file context.
